QuestInfo.name: Team Poni Chai
QuestInfo.0: It seems Poni Chai in Showa Town is lost in thought. You should see what's on her mind.
QuestInfo.1:
Poni Chai doesn't think she can win the race to buy bread during her lunch break. And she's not sure the people she's roped into helping her, Team Poni Chai, are up to the challenge. Maybe you should step in and help Poni Chai? Hmm... she requested #b#t04000092##k and #b#t04000093##k--4 of each. All right, time to get going.


#t04000092#   #b#c04000092##k/4 
#t04000093#   #b#c04000093##k/4
QuestInfo.2: You're skeptical of Poni Chai's plans to buy bread from the cafeteria, but you can't help but cheer her on.

0.0: Chaaaaaaaaarge! This way, follow me! \nReady? Now break for the lunch line!
0.1: Eek! Don't sneak up on me like that!
0.3: Our lunchlady went to some kind of training thingy and she hasn't been at school for two whole weeks. Our school hasn't provided any prepared lunches since she left, so we've had to buy bread from the cafeteria. As soon as the lunch bell rings, whole school races over. By the time I get there, there's nothing left for me but a sad little sausage.
0.4: So I've decided if it's a fight those other kids want, it's a fight they'll get! I'm assembling all my friends to enact my plan for victory...
0.5: The cafeteria is like a battlefield. The moment you enter the chaos, you'll be met by a giant wall of people. You'd think these people had never heard of lines. Obviously, going it solo means starving.
0.6: To break through the enemy defensive line, I'll need backup. That's why I've enlisted all three Maru brothers to help. The plan is to charge in there like a wrecking ball, break through, and get our bread!
0.7: The Maru brothers have been my friends since we were little. They've already agreed to join Team Poni Chai, and signed off on my plan.
0.8: Even with all three of the Maru brothers, when we slam into the defensive line, we'll almost certainly get separated.
0.9: But at that point, we'll have broken through the enemy's defenses, and even on my own I should have enough momentum to beat the others to the front of the snack line!
0.10: I'm buying bread for all three Maru brothers, too!
0.11: The plan is pretty good, but I couldn't help but feel something was missing.
0.12: First, Team Poni Chai needs it's own uniform. I'm thinking a pair of #b#t04000092##k for each of us will make us super intimidating! We'll also need some #b#t04000093#s#k to protect us from harm.
0.13: If you could bring me what I need, I'll be sure to reward you! What do you say?

yes.0: Yaaay! The fate of Team Poni Chai is in your hands.

no.0: I can't spend the rest of my school life surviving on mini-sausages! Please reconsider!

1.0: What do you think? Can we make it work?
1.1: Oh, this is perfect! With this, my plan to buy bread from the cafeteria is sure to succeed! I'll go ahead and hand these out to the Maru brothers.

item.0: This isn't everything I asked for. Look again!
